name: pizza-os
description: We are programming an OS - bare metal pizza kernel @ 1MB
author: Vanna Bee, Troy James

scripts.prod: npm run k:build && NODE_ENV=production pm2 start server.js --name pizza-os --update-env
scripts.k:build: nasm -f elf32 boot.asm -o boot.o && g++ -m32 -ffreestanding -O2 -c kernel.cpp -o kernel.o && g++ -m32 -ffreestanding -O2 -c mm.cpp -o mm.o && g++ -m32 -ffreestanding -O2 -c ai_model.cpp -o ai_model.o && ld -m elf_i386 -T linker.ld -o pizza-os.bin boot.o kernel.o mm.o ai_model.o -nostdlib && cp pizza-os.bin public/pizza-os.bin 2>/dev/null || true && ls -lh pizza-os.bin
scripts.k:check: grub-file --is-x86-multiboot2 pizza-os.bin && echo '✅ VALID multiboot2' || echo '❌ INVALID'; readelf -l pizza-os.bin | grep -A2 NOTE; readelf -n pizza-os.bin | head -20
scripts.k:qemu: npm run k:build && timeout 8 qemu-system-i386 -kernel pizza-os.bin -nographic
scripts.k:iso:
mkdir -p iso/boot/grub && cp pizza-os.bin iso/boot/ && printf 'set timeout=0
serial --unit=0 --speed=9600
terminal_input serial
terminal_output serial
menuentry "pizza-os" { multiboot2 /boot/pizza-os.bin
 boot }
' > iso/boot/grub/grub.cfg && grub-mkrescue -o pizza-os.iso iso && ls -lh pizza-os.iso
scripts.k:qemu-iso: npm run k:build && npm run k:iso && timeout 8 qemu-system-i386 -cdrom pizza-os.iso -nographic
scripts.restart: npm run k:build && pm2 restart pizza-os --update-env || npm run prod
scripts.stop: pm2 stop pizza-os && pm2 delete pizza-os
